yt_title: Light Speed Tak Pahunchna Namumkin Kyun Hai?
short:
Aadhi light speed pe light ko chase karo.
Woh abhi bhi utni hi tezi se door jaayegi.

Andromeda jao — aap 28 saal budhe honge.
Earth 25 lakh saal.

Light speed kabhi speed limit thi hi nahi.
Ye future ka one-way darwaza hai.
cta:
Do baar dekho — aakhri line pehli ka jawab hai 🔁
